newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech crown up, mkt sees govt confidence vote win.
newsitem.headline: Czech crown up, mkt sees govt confidence vote win.

text.p: The Czech crown firmed on Tuesday morning ahead of a crucial parliamentary confidence vote in the centre-right coalition government which dealers say they expect the government to win.
By 0815 GMT the crown had risen to 18.8 against the mark from around 19.1 late on Monday.
"Ahead of the confidence vote you see the crown is strengthening as everyone expects the government will win," said Petr Kukla of Girocredit Bank.

Optimism about the prospects for a government victory increased on Tuesday morning after the leader of a key coalition party, the Christian Democrats (KDU-CSL), was quoted by a local news agency as saying he was happy with emergency budget discussions which lasted into Tuesday morning.
"The market has now discounted a government victory," said Kukla.
The outcome of the budget discussions was widely seen as a test of the government's ability to unite ahead the confidence vote.
Kukla said he expected the market to refocus on macro-economic fundamentals and interest rates after the vote, which may take place as early as Tuesday afternoon.
